title: Higher direct image as a sheafified cohomology presheaf
statement:
Let $h:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes and $F\in\Ab(Y_{\Et})$. Then
$R^qh_*F$ is the sheaf associated with the presheaf

$$
(U\to X)\longmapsto H^q\bigl(U\times_XY,F|_{U\times_XY}\bigr)
$$

on $X_{\Et}$; more generally for $K\in\Dplus(Y_{\Et})$ the cohomology sheaf
$R^qh_*K$ is associated with $U\mapsto H^q(U\times_XY,K|_{U\times_XY})$.
(*Stacks Project, Lemma Tag 03Q8.*)

proof.text: Let $K\in\Dplus(Y_{\Et})$ (for the sheaf clause $K=F$ placed in degree $0$). There are a bounded below complex $I^\bullet$ of injective objects of $\Ab(Y_{\Et})$ and an isomorphism $K\cong QI^\bullet$, and $I^\bullet$ is K-injective [lem-weil-pbc-dplus-injective-representative]; for $K=F$ this may be taken to be an injective resolution $F\to I^\bullet$. By [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], $Rh_*K\cong Q(h_*I^\bullet)$, so $R^qh_*K=\mathcal H^q(h_*I^\bullet)$, and $(h_*I^r)(U)=I^r(U\times_XY)$ for each etale $U\to X$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 072W proof; etale specialization in Lemma Tag 03Q8

proof.text: Fix an etale $U\to X$, put $W=U\times_XY$ with its etale projection $v:W\to Y$, and read $K|_W$ as $v^{-1}K$. The functor $v^{-1}$ is exact [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-exact] and sends injective sheaves to injective sheaves, being right adjoint to the exact functor $v_!$ [lem-weil-pbc-etale-restriction-injectives] (with $R=\mathbf Z$). Hence $v^{-1}K\cong Q(v^{-1}I^\bullet)$ with $v^{-1}I^\bullet$ a bounded below complex of injectives, which is K-injective [lem-weil-pbc-dplus-injective-representative]; so by [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] (resolution independence) $H^q(W,K|_W)=H^q(\Gamma(W,v^{-1}I^\bullet))$. Through the isomorphisms $\rho_{I^r}(W):\Gamma(W,v^{-1}I^r)\xrightarrow{\sim}I^r(W)$, natural in $I^r$ and so compatible with the differentials [lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-restriction] (1), this is $H^q(I^\bullet(W))=H^q\bigl((h_*I^\bullet)(U)\bigr)$. No hypothesis on $h$ is used.

source.place: Lemma Tag 072W proof; etale specialization in Lemma Tag 03Q8

proof.text: Kernels and images of the underlying presheaf complex are sectionwise. Exact sheafification commutes with cohomology of complexes, so the cohomology sheaf $\mathcal H^q(h_*I^\bullet)=R^qh_*K$ is the sheafification of the sectionwise cohomology presheaf, which by the previous step is $U\mapsto H^q(U\times_XY,K|)$. For $K=F$ in degree $0$ this is the ordinary-sheaf clause.
